errors.text_span: x轴为分类轴，没有数值刻度
errors.evidence: The x-axis has category labels A1–C2 and does not show numeric values, but it does have visible tick marks; saying there are no numeric ticks is somewhat misleading. More importantly, the reference notes evenly distributed ticks rather than emphasizing absence of numeric ticks.
The y-axis ticks are labeled 0.003, 0.004, 0.005, and 0.006, indicating an interval of 0.001, not 0.0005.
The description omits the legend details that the red line uses triangle markers and the blue line uses x-shaped markers, which are visible and highlighted in the reference description.
